articles.title: PM Modi to visit Varanasi, Bhubaneswar on Sunday for key inaugurations
articles.summary: Prime Minister Narendra Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on Sunday. In Varanasi, UP, he will witness the Air Force Day aerial display, showcasing India's air power. Subsequently, in Odisha, he is scheduled to inaugurate an RBI data centre and a cyber security training institute, aiming to bolster national financial infrastructure and digital security capabilities. This visit covers key national developments in defence and technology.

articles.title: PM Modi to visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on October 25
articles.summary: Prime Minister Modi will visit Uttar Pradesh and Odisha on October 25. He will inaugurate a garment manufacturing facility in Varanasi and witness an Indian Air Force aerial demonstration. In Odisha, he will launch multiple development projects, including an oil refinery expansion and a new museum, showcasing his focus on national infrastructure and defence engagement.

articles.title: BPCL Q2 profit falls 22.5% to ₹4,993 cr as fuel price freeze hits earnings
articles.summary: State-owned Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) reported a 22.5 per cent fall in its September quarter net profit. This decline was attributed to weakened earnings from operations. The company faced a retail price freeze, which prevented it from passing on rising costs to consumers, significantly impacting its overall profitability during the quarter.

articles.title: BPCL Q2 profit falls 22% as EBITDA slips on fuel price freeze
articles.summary: State-owned Bharat Petroleum Corporation Ltd (BPCL) reported a 22.5% fall in its September quarter net profit. This significant decline was attributed to weakened earnings from operations, primarily due to a retail price freeze on petroleum products. Despite rising input costs, BPCL was unable to adjust retail prices, directly impacting its profitability. This highlights the financial pressures on public sector oil marketing companies amid price regulations.

articles.title: Ukraine says Starlink speed limits lifted after disruptions to military ops
articles.summary: Kyiv reported stable Starshield satellite connections with significantly increased speeds, now exceeding 400 kmph. This improvement follows recent disruptions that impacted crucial drone missions and military logistics. The enhanced and reliable connectivity is vital for Ukraine's ongoing defence operations, ensuring robust communication and data transfer capabilities for its forces on the battlefield.

articles.title: Israel launches new operation in West Bank after gunmen killed two IDF soldiers days before elections
articles.summary: Israel's military launched an operation in the occupied West Bank, retaliating after gunmen killed two IDF soldiers. Occurring days before crucial Israeli elections, this military action adds a significant security dimension to the political climate. Prime Minister Benjamin Netanyahu faces domestic challenges, with the operation underscoring persistent regional tensions and the critical role of security ahead of polls.

articles.title: Russian-Indian BrahMos missile is getting future-ready
articles.summary: BrahMos corporation is actively enhancing its namesake supersonic cruise missile, the BrahMos, following its recent combat successes. The focus is on increasing its destructive power and extending its operational reach. These upgrades aim to further solidify BrahMos's reputation as a formidable weapon system, incorporating lessons learned from its practical deployment to maintain its strategic advantage.

articles.title: [Catholic Caucus Devotional] My Catholic Life! Catholic Daily Reflections: The Goodness of Repentance - Saturday, October 24, 2026
articles.summary: Jesus responded to the news of Galileans killed by Pilate, and victims of a falling tower, by stating their suffering didn't imply greater sin. He emphasized that all individuals, unless they repent, will perish alike. This shifted focus from judging victims' sinfulness to highlighting the universal need for personal repentance and spiritual readiness for everyone.
